facts.title: MAS latest news
facts.takeaway: Masco announced a $300 million accelerated share repurchase on May 7, 2026, and its shares fell 4.6% to about $65 on May 15.

facts.title: Masco up after upbeat first-quarter results
facts.takeaway: Masco's Q1 2026 sales of $1.92 billion beat the roughly $1.84 billion expected, and it reaffirmed 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $4.10 to $4.30.
